module_role: Synthesizable CAN-FD communication controller IP (Bosch M_CAN), integrable as stand-alone or part of an ASIC. Performs communication per ISO 11898-1:2015. Includes CAN Core + Tx/Rx Handlers + Generic Slave Interface (Host CPU) + Generic Master Interface (32-bit Message RAM) + Extension Interface (optional). Requires external CAN transceiver + external Message RAM.
layered_structure_summary: Object Layer — message acceptance filtering (Acceptance Filter + Standard/Extended Filter Elements), Tx + Rx mailbox management.
Transfer Layer (kernel) — BSP, BTL, EML, Acceptance Filter per ISO 11898-1:2015.
Physical Layer — outside M_CAN; external transceiver translates between m_can_tx/m_can_rx and CANH/CANL voltages.

integration_overview.uniform_arbitration_bit_rate: Arbitration bit rate (NBTP) uniform within a CAN network. Data phase bit rate (DBTP) may be higher but must be ≥ arbitration rate.
integration_overview.max_baud_typical: Arbitration ≤ 1 Mbit/s; data phase typically 2 / 5 / 8 Mbit/s.

interface_categories: Generic Slave Interface — Host CPU register access.
Generic Master Interface — 32-bit external Message RAM.
TSU interface — m_can_tsrx + m_can_tstx + m_can_ext_ts inputs.
Extension interface — all IR flags + selected status/control.
interconnect_topologies_supported: Single multi-master bus — all CAN nodes share one physical channel.
Multiple M_CANs sharing the same Message RAM.
Mixed ISO + non-ISO CAN-FD nodes — CCCR.NISO selects which frame format is generated/accepted; mixing on same bus is NOT interoperable.
default_signal_values_when_omitted: Bus idle = all nodes drive recessive. M_CAN's m_can_tx is held recessive (HIGH) under CCCR.INIT = 1.
soc_dependent_items: m_can_hclk choice — may be FM-PLL spread spectrum; must satisfy m_can_hclk ≥ m_can_cclk.
Rx FIFO + Rx Buffer + Tx Buffer / FIFO / Queue + Tx Event FIFO element counts + start addresses.
Synthesis generic parameter choice: iso_only_g, connected_tsu_g, CREL synthesis-stamp values.

low_power_modes.sleep_mode: Triggered via m_can_clkstop_req or CCCR.CSR. After pending Tx complete + bus idle: CCCR.INIT set, m_can_clkstop_ack + CCCR.CSA = 1.
low_power_modes.wake_up: Restart clocks → CPU deasserts m_can_clkstop_req → M_CAN clears m_can_clkstop_ack + CCCR.CSA → CPU clears CCCR.INIT → BSP synchronizes to bus.
low_power_modes.abort_path: If bus is heavily disturbed and idle is never reached, CCCR.INIT is not set automatically; software polls PSR.ACT.

l9_contract_summary.host_cpu_protocol: Memory-mapped 32-bit register bus, 8/16/32-bit access. Protected-Write for configuration. W1C on IR flags.
l9_contract_summary.message_ram_protocol: 32-bit Generic Master Interface; M_CAN drives m_can_aeim_sel + address + write data, RAM responds with m_can_aeim_ready + read data + m_can_aeim_berr[1:0].
l9_contract_summary.phy_protocol: Logical-level m_can_tx + m_can_rx. External transceiver drives differential bus.
l9_contract_summary.interrupt_protocol: Two CPU lines per ILE; per-flag enable + line-select via IE + ILS.
l9_contract_summary.clock_domain_protocol: m_can_hclk ≥ m_can_cclk; Sync block handles cross-domain handoff.
